comment: Literals of Core 2 rewards and the combat end that the web keeps in code (docs/design/11 WP-15; src/model/stanceCoverage.js, gameProfileRewards.js, gracerefill.js, skills.js, xpCurve.js and gameProfileProgression.js at the pinned sha b8cfe4fac). stanceAlias: a stance id the profile lists that a card reads as another (prepared -> casting). cantripTag: the tag that makes a card a cantrip. excludedRarities: the rarities a card reward never offers. lowerRankScale: the die the lowerRankChance is rolled on (a pick among 0..scale-1). defaultActs: the climb's length when the routes module names none. chargeLedgerKeys: the whole-number fields a flask charge ledger must keep. skillKinds: the kinds of skill track. abilitySkill / perceptionSkill: the track ids that are not derived from the tag tree. linearEpsilon: the rounding nudge of a linear curve. xpMultiplierMax: the ceiling of a progression module's XP rate. trackLabels: the names of the tracks that do not come from the registries.
